small_guidance: Output mismatch with avg_difference=nan suggests NaN propagation likely from the fused GELU on c_fc producing inf via exp(2*inner) for large activations. Replace the manual tanh expansion with a numerically stable formulation: compute t = tl.tanh-equivalent via t = 1 - 2/(exp(2*inner)+1) with clamping, or better use the sigmoid form: gelu(x)=x*sigmoid(1.702*x) is wrong; use exact tanh approx with clamp inner to [-10,10] before exp. Also keep allow_tf32=False but verify bias dtype matches acc; cast acc to a.dtype before storing to avoid fp32->fp16 mismatch. Add a config with smaller BLOCK to ease autotune.
large_guidance: Redesign so the GEMM kernel handles fp32 cleanly and avoids overflow in fused activations: split into (1) a plain GEMM+bias kernel and (2) a separate elementwise GELU kernel using tl.tanh (available as libdevice.tanh) or a stable rational approximation, eliminating exp(2x) blowup. Alternatively call torch.nn.functional.gelu after the GEMM. Also support trans_b layout properly with K-major B for c_attn/c_proj since Conv1D weight is (in,out) row-major — verify stride handling. Consider a persistent split-K kernel for the lm_head (large N=50257) to improve occupancy.
